name: Pulsarx
description: Institutional execution infrastructure for on-chain markets — non-custodial, chain-agnostic, margin-native.
longDescription:
1. PulsarX is non-custodial, chain-agnostic execution infrastructure for institutional trading firms and tokenised asset holders, with an in-built advanced algorithmic trading layer.

2. The problem. In traditional markets a desk gets one account, one margin view and credit against its collateral. On-chain none of it exists — every venue is a separate integration, collateral sits idle, and most solutions ask a regulated firm to hand over custody.

3. One account, every venue. Clients connect once and reach every supported venue across every connected chain, with depth aggregated into a single unified book and orders routed on all-in cost.

4. Advanced order types. An in-built execution layer — participation, TWAP, VWAP, implementation shortfall — with pre-trade slicing against live book conditions. Institutional algo execution without a desk building it.

5. Cross-venue margin. Collateral moves between venues in real time, so a position held across two venues is treated as one book rather than two unrelated ones. Two market makers live on it; Derive has publicly supported it.

6. Credit against collateral. A $100M per-client pledging facility with Anchorage Digital at 80% LTV, turning idle collateral into working margin while the client keeps the underlying exposure.

7. Unified risk dashboard. Net position, collateral and margin health across every connected venue in one view — the reporting layer a risk committee requires before approving a mandate.

8. Non-custodial by construction. Clients trade from Safe accounts they own. Permissions are scoped on-chain to whitelisted contracts and function selectors, with no configuration allowing transfer to an external address, revocable at any time and verifiable from the deployed account.

9. Live and revenue-generating. In production on Arbitrum mainnet and BNB Chain across six venue integrations, earning 2 bps on executed notional plus tiered subscriptions at 60% gross margin. No spread, no principal position — we never take the other side of a client trade.

10. Partnerships. Anchorage Digital and Arch Lending, Derive Protocol, Maple Finance, RWA.xyz, Secret Network, Bayut, Bitwise Asset Management — each takes time to build, and each makes the next institution easier to onboard.
